propDocs.Rating.value: Controlled score, or null before a score is chosen.
propDocs.Rating.max: Number of stars in the interactive rating.
propDocs.Rating.step: Smallest selectable fraction of a star.
propDocs.Rating.disabled: Disables every star and excludes the value from forms.
propDocs.Rating.readOnly: Displays a non-interactive image labelled with the rating.
propDocs.Rating.required: Requires a rating before submitting a form.
propDocs.Rating.loop: Wraps keyboard navigation at either end.
propDocs.Rating.deselectable: Pressing the chosen score again clears it.
